title: Practice 2: Dative endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Он скрылся, не уплатив долга по ___ (азартный) игре.
exercises.prompt: He welshed on his gambling debt.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Неоднозначные фразы в целом ведут к ___ (забавный) интерпретациям.
exercises.prompt: Ambiguous phrases in general lead to amusing interpretations.

exercises.prompt: An infrared ray is electromagnetic radiation.
